title: Dolmens tied to a cult of giants
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Dolmens tied to a cult of giants, about ancient at Sardinia, Minorca and elsewhere, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um and I believe that the dolmans are associated with the giants, not just because they're large stones, but they're associated with the cult of giants.

plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino tells podcast host Jesse Michels that dolmens, ancient monuments made of huge standing stones topped by a flat slab and found in places like Sardinia and Minorca, are linked to giants. He says the link is not just that the stones are big, but that they were tied to an ancient cult of giants. If so, it would mean giants played a real part in early human religion.
